sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of U.S. patent law abroad. It asks if supplying one component overseas counts as infringement.

paragraphs: The Supreme Court heard oral argument in this case on December 6, 2016.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Life Technologies wants the Court to rule that supplying one component abroad does not infringe a U.S. patent.
Promega wants the Court to rule that supplying one component abroad does infringe a U.S. patent.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Life Technologies argues that U.S. patent law does not reach the supply of a single component abroad.
Promega argues that U.S. patent law covers the supply of a single component abroad.
